native_model: Hidden-Markov/state-estimation account of learning to use past evidence in an experiment-defined world model
modeled_internal_state: posterior belief over hidden trial state
past-state evidence propagated through transition model
memory_representation_state: internal posterior/belief summarizes past evidence; raw past observations and experiment-defined sequence remain external history/world
prediction_state: posterior distribution over latent current trial state and response likelihood derived from it
learned_parameters: gamma and sigma are fitted/estimated parameters; their change across training summarizes use of evidence, not a source-demonstrated stored episodic trace
action_skill_variables: behavioral response generated from posterior response likelihood
update_transition_rules: HMM transition prior propagates hidden-state belief
retrieval_readout_rules: posterior belief is mapped to response likelihood
prediction_generation_operators: state-estimation/prediction from transition prior plus current observations
learning_plasticity_rules: paper fits gamma across training tertiles; it does not model initial acquisition of the overall transition structure

outside: experiment-defined cyclic transition structure as task world specification

model_variants: more complex asymmetric B variant for some subjects
negative_adverse_results: The latent transition structure is experiment-defined; the fitted HMM is not evidence that this transition structure was learned neurally by the same operator.
The paper does not model initial acquisition of the overall world-model structure; changes in gamma characterize improved use of past evidence.
Gamma and sigma can be moderately anticorrelated, limiting unique mechanistic interpretation.
A more complex asymmetric B variant helps some subjects but is not adopted as the average central model.
anti_conflation_assertions: external past observations are not themselves internal memory state
state estimation is not the same as learning the transition model
fitted gamma/sigma are parameters, not automatically stored memory or coordinator state
posterior response output is distinct from retained model/belief state
